title: BillKladis/Vectorless-RAG-for-Reasoning-Based-Extraction
summary: Vectorless RAG 是一种基于推理的提取系统，它通过推理驱动提取而非向量嵌入来实现检索增强生成，优化了模型训练和推理性能，适用于需要高效处理大量文本数据的场景。
description: Vectorless RAG for Reasoning-Based Extraction — a retrieval-augmented generation system that bypasses vector embeddings in favor of reasoning-driven extraction.
